description: K-fold fine-tune/eval split over the 10 male speakers the male-only model used ONLY for early-stopping selection (val role: no gradient update on their audio, but their accuracy did influence which epoch's checkpoint was kept). This is the largest available matched pool -- the male-only model's train+val already covers all 48 male speakers, so ZERO males have true zero exposure (unlike the 12 women, all of whom are true zero-exposure). Eval sizes [3,3,2,2] (10 does not divide evenly by 4); fine-tune sizes [7,7,8,8] accordingly -- both smaller than the female design's clean 3/9 because the male candidate pool itself is smaller (10, not 12).
n_flag: male control uses WEAK-exposure (val-selection only) speakers, not true zero-exposure speakers like the female pool -- interpret any male-control shift as a conservative (likely underestimated) floor, not a clean analogue of the female condition
